easyPrerequisites: Cheering Fanatic does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker.
Cheering Fanatic triggers, allowing you to choose "Sensei's Divining Top" and reduce the cost of spells with this name by {1} this turn.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Data triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3
